visibility.others: Retain every other receiving visibility state, including useful upper/lower body05 coverts and original machinery. This exact12-sheet hide list defines near-shoulder patch ownership; broader hides need a new declared manifest. Originals preserved untouched and reversible.

criterion.construction: Build only six to eight unique near-shoulder curved sheets as a cassette over narrow dark root-support ribs. Author each cage from a covered-root Bezier rail, free-tip rail and two side rails in3D; adjust the projected cassette boundary to the locked compact backward/downward teardrop while checking candidate03. No source-to-model affine pixel mapping, planar fan sheets, blanket mirroring or whole-envelope generator.
criterion.depth_treatment: Original left broad recess remains hidden. New narrow support ribs carry black-iron receiving material and sit beneath covered roots only, never become a smooth broad outer patch. Deliberately order roots under the preceding sheet; free edges remain just proud of underlying sheets. Validate every visible new sheet vertex/edge against the new local supports and adjacent sheets, not a single center sample. No universal radius offset or broad supporting shell. Backing, sheet and machinery intersections may exist only where they do not show in whole/profile/grazing views.
criterion.limits: 30min hard cap, at most two design attempts; first matched wholebird metal+clay pair by15min. One near shoulder only; no front reconstruction, head, stance, leg/foot, anchor, animation, new material maps, finish/lighting camouflage or production promotion. All original geometry/UVs/color/maps/metadata/hierarchy/transforms preserved; only declared visibility changes. New cages/supports are CG proposals.
criterion.pass: Independent review must see a closer compact swept shield hierarchy and cleaner shoulder integration in the complete bird versus completed06, at unchanged camera04 and receiving metal05/neutral clay. Profile and grazing must show intentional overlap without broad exposed smooth backing, buried tips, crossed sheets or new gaps. Local closeup appeal without fullbird source gain fails.
criterion.fail: Reject if hiding the broad recess merely creates dark voids, cassette flares into hanging wing geometry, source layers remain disconnected islands or wholebird has no visible improvement. Restore original visibility; do not count support/sheetwork objects or preservation tests as likeness.
criterion.front_failure: Keep rejected body08 front strips out. Front/neck fitted plate continuity remains a separate unresolved correction after this isolated support-topology experiment.
